method: Extracted actual handler arrow function from exact-head TypeScript AST, transpiled it, and supplied distinct fake Window references. No browser used; no replacement gate implementation.

cases.label: Latest recorded debug window receives auth then attach
Older debug window is ignored despite same origin and same ready payload
Debug window is ignored when current reference is absent
Actual iframe window remains accepted alongside current debug window

limitations: This proves Builder receiver routing by Window identity; it does not observe the live debug tab or prove browser postMessage source semantics.
No credential values or raw MessageEvents are logged.
A visible fixture timeout remains an observed failure until the newest-tab retry succeeds.
